author: /root
review_scope: Independent review of the root-authored documentary protocol, evidence ceiling, bounded source accounting, reproducibility and transition rules. This is not the final physical readiness attestation or a new reproof of the four foundation resolutions.
contribution_disclosure: The reviewer previously suggested an access-feasibility protocol, source budget and outcome categories after reading the historical owners. The reviewer did not author or edit these three drafts; this receipt assesses their concrete formulation.

assessments.question: The proposed task asks whether independent access is documented rather than assuming an actuator, full preparation, observation dictionary or empirical bridge already exists. It can expose a missing or incompatible access condition without scoring a physical response.
assessments.bounded_selection: The order of three terrestrial apparatus families and at most one selected apparatus per family constrain scope. Six primary documents and six targeted queries are hard maxima. A separate article, supplement and repository acquisition document count separately; an unavailable selected item remains in the ledger. Selection uses independently documented access rather than waveform resemblance.
assessments.reproducibility: The final draft records each source identity, URL, selection reason, access date and available version/DOI/revision/commit, plus the supporting section or page for each extracted fact. Unknown metadata stay unknown. The two review clarifications concern provenance and stopping semantics rather than expanding the permitted study.
assessments.stopping: At either source/query limit the task stops new searches and selections, then classifies only already admitted material without extra retrievals or queries. The audit closes even if no candidate survives. It cannot expand because a lead appears promising or silently replace inaccessible selected items.
assessments.historical_reuse: The existing oscillator inventory supplies starting metadata and prior exposure. Its earlier Rössler, DPLL, quartz/MEMS and electrochemical conclusions retain their original model and observation scope. The protocol does not automatically admit those sources to JO/FO or transfer a different model's exclusion.
assessments.evidence: The source table must separate source-backed facts, missing information and proposed interpretations, retaining actual support, full published state, exterior inputs, memory, preparation, selective control, companion rows, reactions, calibration, clock and uncertainties. An extracted phase or capacity-like rate does not establish the TNFR coordinate by name.
assessments.evidence_ceiling: The strongest positive outcome is a candidate warranting a separate bridge review. Documented incompatibility is local to a stated required access condition, while missing, inaccessible or not yet comparable evidence remains insufficient rather than a physical impossibility theorem. None of the categories admits an experiment, physical variable identification or application of the FO threshold.
assessments.uncertainty: The protocol correctly prohibits directly comparing published instrument precision to the native 2^-166 sufficient budget without a justified unit, gain and clock bridge. That budget is not asserted necessary, so failure to establish it is not a universal exclusion.
assessments.implementation_boundary: A device programmed to implement the equations may demonstrate implementation or control but does not independently establish those equations as a natural law or derive its constituents. Another apparatus's methods and an ideal compensator cannot fill the current source's missing causal evidence.
assessments.execution_boundary: Only primary methods and acquisition documentation may be inspected. Raw signal archives, response extraction, plot digitization, fitted parameters, model outputs, new simulations, controller installation and apparatus construction are excluded. Published descriptions remain prior exposure rather than reserved validation.
assessments.readiness_and_transition: The program marks this as physical activity and requires the unchanged strict guard before external source inspection. Final readiness must bind exact program bytes and all current prerequisite reviews. Completion cannot implicitly authorize a new bridge, mapping, fit, changed consumer or expanded budget; those need a new exact-task admission.

limitations: This review does not inspect external sources, verify that any listed apparatus has the required access, or admit a physical realization.
The source-only budget can legitimately yield no candidate; inaccessible material and absent documentation must remain explicit.
The four scoped foundation closures and final readiness require their own substantive reviews and current hash associations.
